# NorthLedger Tools

> Free, ad-free calculators for Canadians (2026 tax year), built on rates published by the Canada Revenue Agency and Revenu Québec. Each page cites its sources and links to a paid NorthLedger spreadsheet that adds year-round logging and tracking. Estimates only, not tax advice.

## Calculators
- [TFSA Contribution Room Calculator 2026](https://northledgertools.github.io/tfsa-contribution-room-calculator/): room rebuilt year by year from 2009 using CRA limits ($7,000 for 2026, $109,000 cumulative); withdrawals added back the following January 1.
- [FHSA Contribution Room Calculator 2026](https://northledgertools.github.io/fhsa-contribution-room-calculator/) ([français : CELIAPP](https://northledgertools.github.io/calcul-droits-celiapp/)): participation room year by year from the year the first FHSA was opened; $8,000 annual, carry-forward capped at $8,000 (max $16,000 in a year), $40,000 lifetime; RRSP transfers use room; withdrawals do not restore it.
- [Self-Employed Tax Calculator 2026, Ontario / BC / Alberta](https://northledgertools.github.io/self-employed-tax-calculator/): federal + provincial income tax, CPP (11.9%, max $8,460.90) and CPP2 (8%, max $832) on self-employment income.
- [Calcul impôt travailleur autonome Québec 2026](https://northledgertools.github.io/impot-travailleur-autonome-quebec/) ([English](https://northledgertools.github.io/quebec-self-employed-tax-calculator/)): Quebec + federal tax with 16.5% abatement, QPP 12.6% / 8%, QPIP 0.764%, Health Services Fund.
- [RRSP Tax Refund Calculator 2026](https://northledgertools.github.io/rrsp-tax-refund-calculator/) ([français : remboursement REER](https://northledgertools.github.io/calcul-remboursement-reer/)): income tax with vs without the RRSP deduction for Ontario, Quebec, BC and Alberta (2026 federal 14%–33%, provincial brackets and credits, Quebec 16.5% abatement); 2026 RRSP dollar limit $33,810.
- [Freelancer Tax Set-Aside Calculator 2026, ON / BC / AB](https://northledgertools.github.io/freelancer-tax-set-aside-calculator/): % of each dollar of self-employment profit to save for income tax + CPP/CPP2, monthly target and quarterly instalments ($3,000 net tax owing threshold).
- [Acomptes provisionnels 2026, travailleur autonome Québec](https://northledgertools.github.io/acomptes-provisionnels-travailleur-autonome-quebec/) ([English](https://northledgertools.github.io/quebec-tax-instalments-calculator/)): quarterly instalments to Revenu Québec (tax + QPP + QPIP + FSS) and the CRA (federal tax after abatement); $1,800 threshold; current-year and prior-year methods; due Mar 15, Jun 15, Sep 15, Dec 15.
- [Homebrew calculator](https://northledgertools.github.io/homebrew-calculator/): ABV (OG−FG)×131.25, IBU (Tinseth), SRM (Morey), priming sugar.

## Paid spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets / LibreOffice)

- [Self-Employed Tax Estimator 2026 (ON, BC, AB)](https://northledgertools.gumroad.com/l/bblrt): CA$17
- [Quebec Self-Employed Tax Estimator 2026 (bilingual)](https://northledgertools.gumroad.com/l/oymrg): CA$17
